findings.title: The SF2 prefix repair was over-applied into malformed cross-lineage labels
findings.finding: The two required SF2 paths are repaired, but a mechanical sweep also changed already-qualified component-manifest and g15 references. The subject now contains 9 occurrences of 'g15 component-manifest leftover-join.v6' and 4 occurrences of 'component-manifest component-manifest leftover-join.v6' across 11 fields. Neither label names a pinned artifact; D-290 records g15 leftover-join.v6, while D-174 records component-manifest leftover-join.v6. The purpose additionally calls its newly prefixed component-manifest token 'bare'. This defeats the citation-clarity goal and contradicts fields that say the two lineages are distinct.
findings.requiredRepair: Keep the correct component-manifest prefix at basedOn.d174.role and basedOn.occupancyV9.role, restore every G15 reference to 'g15 leftover-join.v6', restore every doubled reference to 'component-manifest leftover-join.v6', and make purpose describe the original bare-token defect rather than call the repaired token bare. Change no pin, partition member, currency conclusion, or frozen predecessor.

findings.title: The cumulative landing ledger omits the two findings v11 says it lands and contradicts itself
findings.finding: authorityClaim, purpose, and the end of landsNote say v11 lands both v10 Claude findings. However, findingDisposition has no entry for either identifier, lands is the unchanged 11-member v10 array, and landsNote first says v11 'lands no new finding identifier' before saying it lands those two. The lineage's v8 and v9 successors appended predecessor-review findings to both findingDisposition and lands when claiming to land them.
findings.requiredRepair: Using only the two existing v10 finding identifiers, add their accepted dispositions at the substantive repair paths, extend lands consistently, and make landsNote state one non-contradictory landing history. Do not add CMLJ-V1-B1 to lands and do not mint any identifier.

findings.title: Predecessor roles retain stale adjacency labels after adding v10
findings.finding: The subject is v11 and explicitly exists to repair v10, yet predecessorV9 still says 'Immediate predecessor', predecessorV8 still says 'Direct frozen predecessor', and predecessorV10 says only 'Predecessor'. V9 is correctly the current recorded DR-103 join at draft time, but that custody standing does not make it the immediate versioned predecessor of v11.
findings.requiredRepair: Call component-manifest leftover-join.v10 the immediate frozen predecessor; call v9 the current recorded predecessor at draft time; call v8 historical. Preserve the correct D-282 currency and successor-recorded qualifier.

shouldFix: v10 finding landing-ledger omission and contradiction
decisionRule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. Three SHOULD-FIX findings survived adversarial review, so the required verdict is REJECT.
summary: REJECT at 0 MUST-FIX and 3 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody, all 46 file-backed pins, frozen anchors, HEAD, file 08, COORD, the 51-fixture audit, the unchanged four-member leftoverDesign partition, OBL-OD-2 false, D-293 authority, and both named v10 repair paths reproduce. Rejection is required because the SF2 prefix sweep corrupts 13 lineage labels, the cumulative ledger omits and contradicts the two findings v11 says it lands, and stale predecessor roles still call v9/v8 immediate or direct instead of v10.
authorityOfThisVerdict: Independent Stage A review evidence only. REJECT does not apply or record component-manifest leftover-join.v11, does not alter any lineage or frozen artifact, does not SATISFY DR-103, does not assign OD-1's owner or decide its numbers, does not fold OD-2, does not execute fixtures, does not authorize implementation, mints no identifier, and creates no commit.
